contenders.handicapper_notes: Solo Lock top pick. Tactical presser ('P') from effective barrier 2 with rail +6m Entire (+1.5 pts) in a race reduced to five runners with #7 Don't Back Down as lone 'E' speed. Warwick Farm Metro shipper for Gary Portelli (+3.5 pts Sydney strike-zone angle) coming off a dominant career-best SR 71 Cl1 win at Canberra over 1600m on Soft ground, beating #7 by 4.2L. Carries 57.5kg (127 lbs) and projects an ideal stalking trip behind the leader before unleashing over Goulburn's 24m-wide, 400m home straight.

Clear second pick. Midfield swooper ('S') trained at Kembla Grange (Tier 2 Provincial) stepping out to 2100m after a solid 2L sixth in a 2000m Canberra BM60 (SR 55) and a narrow 0.4L second at Nowra prior (SR 60). Goulburn's long 400m straight and 24m width suit his closing profile (+2.5 pts), though the +6m rail and 59.0kg (130 lbs) topweight at 2100m on Soft 6 apply a mild weight/position tax.

Danger Horse. Post-scratch Lone Speed ('E', +6.0 pts) after scratches removed early pace rivals #3, #6, and #8. Carries a featherweight 55.0kg (121 lbs) and finished a nose second at 2000m at Canberra two back (SR 59). However, remains a seven-start maiden beaten 4.2L by Iron Rebel last start and Goulburn's testing 400m straight exposes weak front-runners late (-2.5 pts).

Off-pace swooper ('S') who draws the inside effective rail slot with late rider change to Shaun Guymer. Class drop from Provincial Gosford/Hawkesbury fails the <=5.0L beaten margin filter after finishing 13.5L behind at Gosford last start (SR 37). Still, she placed 3rd by 0.8L over this exact Goulburn 2100m Soft trip in July (SR 62) and carries 57.0kg (126 lbs).

Tactical presser ('P') shipping from Victoria (Anti-Clockwise) to race Clockwise for the first time for local Goulburn trainer Tash Burleigh with Jean Van Overmeire aboard at 57.0kg (126 lbs). Recent VIC BM52 form at Mildura and St Arnaud (SR 44-46) leaves her well short on speed figures against Iron Rebel and Zippy Lion.

contenders.handicapper_notes: Capitalizes massively on the scratches of principal speed rivals Zoutempus and Shoreman to emerge as the uncontested Lone Speed (+6). Boasts commanding tactical speed and secures the coveted fence run from barrier 1 on a +6m portable rail setup. Local Goulburn-trained mare by Tash Burleigh dropping back from stronger BM65/BM66/BM74 company into Country Boosted BM58 grade. Effective weight of 59.5kg is offset by the soft lead geometry.

Designated Danger Horse. Enters off an eye-catching last-start victory at Canberra over 1000m on soft ground on Nov 3. Receives significant weight relief courtesy of apprentice Jordan Quince's 2.0kg claim down to 54.0kg. Superb wet-track statistics (Soft/Heavy: 14 starts for 1 win and 6 placings). Perfectly mapped to stalk just off the leader and unleash late in the 400m straight.

Produced a blistering return from a 20-month spell when finishing an unlucky 2nd beaten just 0.4 lengths over 900m at Albury on Nov 6. Enters 2nd-up peak cycle, drawn ideally in barrier 3 to secure the box-seat trail behind Xspiritous. Will appreciate the testing 400m home straight to mount a sustained sprint under Sairyn Fawke.

Consistent Keith Dryden mare equipped with the field's sharpest final 400m sectional sprint. Ran on strongly for 3rd over 1200m at Sapphire Coast on Nov 5 following a solid placing at Canberra. While barrier 11 is wide, Goulburn's 24m wide championship layout and 400m run-in give Alysha Collett ample time to swoop down the outside.

Benefited by a 36-day freshen-up following an unsuited staying attempt over 1450m at Queanbeyan. Returns to her optimal sprint trip where she won a Canberra BM50 over 1000m and ran 2nd to Showtime Maggie over 1200m. Proven at Goulburn (1 start for 1 win). Wide draw neutralized by her swooping profile.

Gains a start from emergency ranks. Showed good resilience when 3rd at Moruya over 1200m on Nov 3. Picked up late rider Glenn Cahill who claims 1.5kg down to 57.0kg. Possesses early tactical speed to press forward across the face, though the wide gate against lone leader Xspiritous will require early exertion.

contenders.handicapper_notes: Best Bet and Post-Scratch Lone Speed (+6 pts) after scratches of #5 Don't Tell Polly and #10 Angels Cloud leave him as the sole genuine 'E' front-runner. Drawn barrier 3 on a +6m rail (+1.5 pts), 2nd-up peak fitness (+1.5 pts), carrying 58kg. Placed in both prior Goulburn starts (2:0-0-2) and proven on Soft (9:1-1-1); beaten just a nose after leading at Nowra 7f on 1Nov26 ahead of #3 and #12. Even with Goulburn's 400m straight, an uncontested lead gives him a decisive tactical edge.

Sydney Metro/Warwick Farm shipper (+3.5 pts) from the Bjorn Baker yard earning the Class Drop bonus (dropping from Nowra Bm66 3rd within 2.8L on 1Nov26 and Kembla Bm64 to Country Bm58). Proven wet-tracker with a Heavy win. 'P' presser style should sit handy from barrier 8 via Goulburn's forgiving 1400m chute (wide draw penalty capped at -1 pt). Main anchor against her is the 61.5kg topweight on Soft 6 over 7f (-3.0 pts).

Danger Horse. Rosehill Metro shipper (+3.5 pts) for Ryan and Alexiou with Tom Sherry sticking after breaking his maiden at Nowra over 7f on 1Nov26. Drawn barrier 2 on the +6m rail (+1.5 pts) with a 'P' running style that projects the ideal box-seat trail directly behind lone leader #8 Sure Intentions. Unbeaten at 1400m (1:1-0-0), though stepping up from Maiden to Bm58 with 60.8kg (-2.5 pts) and 0-for-2 on Soft.

Consistent Canberra raider (Nick Olive and Alysha Collett) bringing competitive Class 2 form (7th by 1.7L at Canberra 6f on 3Nov26, 5th by 1.4L at Goulburn 6.5f prior). Tactical 'P' style should settle midfield-handy with cover around 57.5kg. Reliable place and trifecta contender, though 0-from-2 at Goulburn and 0-from-3 at 7f (one placing) keep her slightly below the top three.

Progressive 4yo from the Dryden and Snowden stable (Brodie Loy rides) returning 2nd-up (+1.5 pts) after a last-to-first maiden win over 6f at Canberra on 23Oct26. Carries 58.5kg stepping up to 7f. Deep 'C' closer style faces a tough map chasing lone speed #8 on a +6m rail (-2.0 pts), relying on Goulburn's 24m-wide 400m straight to flash late.

Local Goulburn mare trained by Tash Burleigh with Jean Van Overmeire booked at a featherweight 55kg. Proven at the track (4:1-0-0) and on Soft turf (6:1-0-1), having run 4th over 6.5f here on Soft on 6Oct26 before finishing 3L behind #8 Sure Intentions at Nowra. 'S' swooper profile needs tempo, which is compromised by the lone-speed setup.

Canberra 7f winner (5:1-1-0 at the trip) with Nick Heywood aboard carrying 58.5kg. However, his last two runs at Canberra were well below par (9th by 7L in Cl2 and 8th by 7.9L on Soft 6), and he is 0-for-3 on Soft surfaces. 'S' backmarker map from barrier 9 against a +6m rail and lone speed leaves him needing a big turnaround.
